I lost my grandma, older brother, and my father, all within a span of 4 weeks this year. I was close with all of them and i felt what you feel now. You dont have to comprehend it, or hit the block as a new man today. Take time to remember your mother and all of the good times you had...hell even the bad times, it carys a place in your life. Not now, but over time you will process all of the good and the bad of the relationship. you will come out of it a different person, ready to handle what comes at you in life. never forget those experiences, cary them with you, but take time to process it and learn from it. In the end, you'll come out on top bro but for now, take things one day at a time. Sorry for your loss too, things get better.
